With the full trajectory every cell-seed is a genuine matched-achieved-norm comparison; the 20k numbers are retained as a labeled sensitivity column.
primary_endpoint: paired margin difference at a common achieved-norm budget (frontier mean over the overlap range)

D5.statement: advantage survives both frame-favorable capacity controls (+1.82 at 2x width, +2.30 at extra layer, each p=0.0312, all seeds positive): architecture-robust evidence
